rules.statement: A booking must be for at least one ticket, given as a whole number.
rules.subject: booking ticket count

evidence.quote: if (session.status !== "open") throw new DomainError(409, "ticket sales for this session are closed");

rules.statement: Tickets can only be sold for a session that is open.
rules.subject: session status for ticket sales

rules.statement: Each requested hire skate quantity must be a whole number of zero or more.
rules.subject: hire skate quantity per size

evidence.quote: if (this.stock.get(size) === 0) throw new DomainError(400, `no hire skates of size ${size}`);

rules.statement: Hire skates can only be requested in sizes the rink stocks.
rules.subject: hire skate size stock

rules.statement: A booking cannot hire more skates than it has tickets.
rules.subject: hire skates per booking

rules.statement: A membership gives at most four free entries per calendar month, counting active bookings in that month.
rules.subject: member free entries per month

evidence.quote: if (input.tickets > avail.ticketsLeft) throw new DomainError(409, "not enough tickets left");

rules.statement: A booking cannot be for more tickets than the session has left.
rules.subject: tickets requested vs tickets left

rules.statement: For each size, the hire skates requested cannot exceed the skates of that size still available for the session.
rules.subject: hire skates requested per size vs available

evidence.quote: const amountCents = (membershipNumber ? 0 : input.tickets * session.priceCents) + hireCount * HIRE_PRICE_CENTS;

rules.statement: Members pay nothing for tickets; everyone else pays the session price per ticket, and every hired skate costs the hire price.
rules.subject: booking amount

rules.statement: A booking with nothing to pay is confirmed as paid right away; otherwise it stays pending until payment.
rules.subject: initial booking status

rules.statement: A pending booking that is not paid within the payment window expires and its reservation is released.
rules.subject: pending booking payment window

rules.statement: A refund can only be applied to a booking that has been paid.
rules.subject: booking status for refund

rules.statement: A payment or failure result only changes a booking that is still pending, so late payments do not bring back expired or released bookings.
rules.subject: booking status for payment result
